## Cursor

1. **Open the configuration** — Open ~/.cursor/mcp.json. Create the file if it does not exist yet.
2. **Add Backlane** — Copy the configuration and save it in the file. If you already have servers, add the backlane entry.
3. **Sign in & use it** — Open the MCP settings in Cursor and sign in to Backlane. You can then use Backlane in Agent chat.

**~/.cursor/mcp.json**

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "backlane": {
      "url": "https://app.getbacklane.com/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

Already have a configuration? Add only the backlane entry and keep your existing servers.

[Official instructions](https://cursor.com/docs/mcp)

## Check the connection

> Which marketplaces have I connected to Backlane?

Ask your AI assistant to call Backlane's list_integrations tool. A successful tool call confirms the MCP connection. An empty connection list means a marketplace still needs connecting; it is not an MCP connection failure.
